data.body:
[P2] Acknowledge successful input delivery in the local runner

A FLAT parallel using `first_successful()` can leave branch wait B pending while the root waits on A. When B completes, this call delivers B during a checkpoint-free PENDING resume that skips the completed parallel. The testing runner clears `UpdatedOperationIds` at invocation start but never advances `handler_seen_seq` after that valid response. After A completes, a subsequent step checkpoint returns B again, and the fresh invocation ledger lets both OTel views export its completion again. Pair eager delivery with acknowledgment of the captured invocation sequence after response validation, preserving newer updates, and add a regression covering this three-invocation sequence.
